reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed on 2026-10-15 from successful pinned Ethereum reads at block 26197300, hash 0xcc2d6fe52717666f3a8700dbef29e3c77c5657a006aaac60c928cba68a12ab03, timestamp 2026-10-15T10:25:11Z, observed 2026-10-15T10:45:07.170Z and 2026-10-15T10:46:29.506Z. The native implementation remains 0x2b7074cf6681382b70e239063931ebe83c0f4e0a. STRConModule and STRCMirrorModule remain 0x3c0f0b502aa7c2ed85620f7f52b8efb8049b1ecf and 0xa2cf4b9410cebcdceb3cff772ac0219f6d1105c9. STRCon recognizedValue was 50,957,019.855957 USDat-equivalent, actual vault USDat was 587,670.863597, and legacy mirror recognizedValue and getUnvestedSurplus were both zero. Gross identified reserves and totalAssets therefore both equal 51,544,690.719554 USDat-equivalent. The vault held 482,402.190105332645065269 STRCon. Percentages use actual USDat plus recognized STRCon value, retaining the same gross denominator convention as the prior review. These are contract-recognized reserve weights, not independent securities/liabilities reconciliation, executable liquidation values, direct Strategy share ownership or assurance. BNB and Monad representations are not additional underlying reserves; legal and custody conclusions retain their prior unresolved scope.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Gross identified Ethereum reserves = actual vault USDat balance + STRConModule recognizedValue = totalAssets + getUnvestedSurplus; zero legacy mirror and zero unvested surplus at block 26197300
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All operational NAV positions are identified, so unresolved composition identity exposure is zero. For the dominant STRCon slice, exact current note terms, Strategy preferred seniority, dated off-chain reconciliation, Saturn deed-of-gift execution, legal priority, default recovery and realizable liquidity are not established. Those credit/legal uncertainties remain explicit in the local mechanism overlay; zero unidentified composition is not zero financial risk. Family-level Ondo safeguards are not upgraded to Saturn holder safeguards.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The vault's current on-chain note location is verified, while issuer documentation still describes legacy off-chain STRC at Clear Street. The V2 runbook moves STRC to Alpaca, identifies Saturn Fund Ltd., Saturn Global Capital Investments Ltd. and Saturn Vault Corporation, and instructs dating a deed of gift, but its planning text does not establish executed legal rights. Whole-book custody safeguards and provider shares are unknown. Ondo family bankruptcy-remoteness and security-agent claims do not prove sUSDat holder priority against any Saturn entity.
